steps.name: Food for Mir (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Harmonia] in "Belos of memories", get <Special Stir-fried Octopus> from the restaurant in "Elias". And bring it to [Mir] in the “Burning City.”

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Thank you Adventurer for listening to my request. I'm preparing food for Mir. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine, Harmonia. Then, can you tell me?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes, I will tell you. If you've ever talked to Mir, you'd know.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Mir is a Plutonian dragon, but has an appearance that is close to a human.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I was born weak as a child, but with the help of my sisters and spirits, I overcame it and was able to live in a new way.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: The power of Goddess Ceres that remained in Zenadia was a blessing to Mir. And as I gained mystical abilities, I accepted it as my mission.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Talk to spirits, receive revelation from God, and deliver messages... . It may be a daunting task for Mir, who is still a child, but he is doing really well.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: So I wanted to give him a gift. It's Mir's favorite food.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, food made by spirits! I’m looking forward to it!

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: But there is a slight problem. I am the spirit king of ‘harmony’ and ‘stability’. I can't leave this anxious mental world to cook.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: And even if I make the food, I don’t think I can get the taste Mir wants. Although I drink natural essential oils, I have never eaten artificially prepared food.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whatever it is, it's because I can't cook.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rather than making and giving away tasteless food, it is wiser to get delicious food and deliver it.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes, you understood right away.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: So, I want Adventurer to get some food for Mir.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what food is good?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: One day, Mir told me about passing by a restaurant called Elias.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I smelled delicious food and wanted to try it, but I was busy so I couldn't go in... .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: However, Mir wasn't busy at the time. Because he was afraid of the reactions of people who were surprised to see him, not in the form of a spirit, a dragon, or a human.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something like that happened.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: So I want to serve the food that the child couldn't eat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go and get it. Because I know where the restaurant in Elias is.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I would like you to bring two plates of that dish to Mir, as he would be very disappointed with just one plate. I'm sure you'll like Mir too, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure you'll eat well. Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Thank you. Please be careful.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Adventurer!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, what a surprise!

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: This thing Adventurer is holding is definitely... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Food made at Elias’s restaurant!!

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I don't know what the ingredients are, but anyway, this food is delicious!! I heard it was expensive. How did you get it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He tells the story of how Harmonia asked for food for Mir.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Harmonia, wow... . I'm so glad you don't cook yourself... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Anyway, please give it to me. I want to eat it quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a bit chilly since I came from GENDIA. Still, I think it would be delicious.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Cooled down? are you okay. I don't have any problem. The fire spirits here will warm you up!

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: (Mir calls upon the fire spirit and asks it to hold a plate of cold food for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: (The fire spirit holds a plate of food and returns it to Mir.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Look! It was piping hot!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The fire spirit is not a microwave but a circle... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I heard there was such a device in Atlantis. Anyway, it's warmed up!! Well then, let’s eat well!!

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: (Mir pushes all the food into his mouth.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: (Mir’s expression becomes very distorted.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Doesn't it taste good? I think the food was very delicious. There is no problem when you taste it. But why is that?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Is this a octopus?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, special stir-fried octopus.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Please save me. Ugh.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Humanly, no. Spiritually, no. Dragon-wise... . anyhow! Octopus is terrible.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I once received an oracle and went to deliver a message that a certain area needed to be properly organized... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: There was a horrible adult octopus there. You there, you came to see me, babe. Be careful not to fall in love with my beautiful appearance. Ugh.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Imagine being caught and hearing these stories for days. Plus, there were a lot of strange cats, so I suffered mentally.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Ugh… . That octopus... . Ugh. I feel like I'm dying just thinking about it... . Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The adult octopus is a bit greasy, but Mir refuses to eat it... . How much have you suffered?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: … If you bring me any other food, I will eat it as much as I want, so please put that octopus away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Hmm, is this the end? It's a bit ambiguous... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I hate octopus... . It's gross. asleep… . Something like sea squirt, sea cucumber, and sea anemone... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you fall over while eating, it's serious... . Oh, let's go to Harmonia and discuss it first. If things continue like this, I feel like I'm working... .

steps.name: Food for Mir (3)
steps.objective: Talk to “a priest” in a room in “Zenadia Ground Garden.”

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Adventurer? His expression doesn't look very good. Is there something wrong with Mir?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Mir says that while eating stir-fried octopus, he remembered being tormented by an adult octopus.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: You're an interesting person. But I think it would be too much to put Mir in trouble.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not too much, it's just too much.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Have you also met Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, just for a moment. A resident of another planet who seems to have imitated someone I used to know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now that I think about it, Siam… what happened to Siam? I think I’m forgetting something…)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: What are you thinking like that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I guess I was distracted for a moment.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Even if Mir is a spirit, he is half a living being. So I think it would be a good idea to give it a little rest.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I hope Adventurer works hard once more.  sorry… . I wanted to be nice to Mir... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mir will understand too. So what should we do now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can’t think of a dish more luxurious than the special stir-fried octopus… .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I heard that humans miss the food of their hometown. Iris also wants to have a delicious meal at Belos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, if it is Mir’s hometown… .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Zenadia Garden is said to be divided into land and water.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Adventurer, can you go for Mir and me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I can go. But who should I go and ask?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: When young Mir was losing the light of life, there was a priest who helped him. I'm not sure of the name, but they say he's in a space called the 'Healing Room'.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will come back.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Food for Mir (4)
steps.objective: Obtain “Xenadia New Potatoes” and “Xenadia Sweet Potatoes” and report them to [Mir] in the “Burning City.”

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Adventurer looks familiar. How are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Me?

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Do you not remember me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Eh, maybe I remember that, maybe I don’t… .

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Well, that's enough. It doesn't matter now.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: So what brought you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard that Mir grew up here.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Do you know Mir?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. How did I know about Mir? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell the story of meeting Mir while visiting the image world of Iris.)

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Who would have thought it was the goddess... . I need to inform the priests and sisters right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have a question. If Iris became a goddess, shouldn't the priests and sisters naturally know about it?

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: You may not know this, but Zenadia's perception of time and space is different from other places.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Just as the world cannot know everything about this place, this place cannot know everything about the world.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Since the Goddess is not yet in control of her own power, we may not be aware of it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Anyway, now is not the time to explain this. It's food that Mir would like... . You don't have to worry about that.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: The child just needs to eat a lot. There's a lot of food around here that he likes, so take a lot of it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is the food here? All I can see are buildings and circles... .

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: If you look in the underground garden, there are a lot of sweet potatoes and potatoes, so dig them up and bring them to Mir.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Since he receives a lot of blessings from the goddess and spirits, it won't matter if I give him all the ingredients. Do you want to boil or bake it on your own?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you satisfied with this?

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Mir will be happy just to tell you that you came to Zenadia for him. Because that child cherishes people who care about him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Thank you, priest. I think I should give you something... .

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: There seems to be some delicious-smelling food in there. Is it beef jerky?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, this is beef jerky from a place called Lu Men.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Can you give me some too? Hmm… . This is delicious. (squishy squishy)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, if you already have it in your mouth... . Phew, I can't help it. I'll give you everything. Anyway, thank you.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: What do you do with something like that? See you later. (Squishy), this beef jerky is quite delicious. (squishy squishy)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I hate octopus... . Dirty, unclean, disgusting... . Ugh

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you still like that? are you okay?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I'm fine. Adventurer… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's still not in good condition.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I'm fine. As long as you have something to eat, you will recover quickly. Unless it's octopus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I prepared some food.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Uh, this is… .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Potatoes and sweet potatoes... . Hmm. It smells like water, so I guess that's where it came from.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Genadia… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Suddenly, I remembered the time I spent there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this a sad memory?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: No. I was always happy. Everyone took warm care of me.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Still, the food the priests cooked was not tasty... . Since you have the taste for dragons, you mainly eat raw foods.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: What can I say, my taste buds are more sensitive than humans. That's probably why I eat so much.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Anyway, thank you. It must be heavy since you brought so much with you. Now, give it to me. I'll eat it all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I just eat it? What if I don’t cook?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Of course not. The fire and water spirits here will help you.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: (The spirits of fire and water whine and take potatoes and sweet potatoes.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: So what should we make? Since we have cheese, let’s make gratin! Spirits of fire and water, please!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's definitely unusual to ask spirits to cook for you.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Hey, Adventurer! There is a cheese potato gratin here, so go ahead and try one. The rest will be removed so don't touch it.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: (Mir looks satisfied when he sees dozens of plates of cheese and potato gratin laid out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Then enjoy it. And be nice to Harmonia.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Hehe, of course. And Adventurer. Please continue to look after us.
